info.name: SocioMart API - Complete Controller Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman Import Collection covering all 16 @RestController controllers across SocioMart Spring Boot application.
Includes endpoints for Auth, Health, Marketplace, Discovery, Buyer Profile & Orders, Favourites, Enquiries, Notifications, Analytics, Seller Kitchen & Products, Seller App / Dashboard V3, Recurring Schedules, Admin Console, Password Recovery, and Super Admin.

item.name: 1. Authentication (AuthController)
item.description: Endpoints under /api/auth: registration, credential login, password reset/recovery, session info and logout.

request.description: Returns frontend flags: directAuthEnabled, demoRegistrationEnabled, adminLoginConfigured, superAdminLoginConfigured
Returns coverage options (active areas & societies) for buyer & seller registration
Registers a new Buyer account and establishes session.
Registers a seller and creates pending storefront awaiting admin approval.
